text:
mira t: FYI opened a docs PR to reconcile rate-limit wording across pricing, quotas, and metering pages. Also fixes two broken dashboard deep-links and swaps the JS/Python SDK snippets to the new client API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421

leo: Thanks — can you list the specific anchors that broke? I spent 10 minutes chasing a 'per-user quotas' anchor that redirected to a different section.

mira t: Sure. Broken anchors were: `#per-user-quotas` -> now `#user-quota-behavior`, and `#token-meter-panel` on metering.md -> panel param renamed to `panel_id=tm_usage`. I updated both in the PR.

sophie: Heads-up: CI link-checker flagged an external docs link to the billing faq (we moved it last week). Suggest replacing with /support/billing/usage-billing-guide rather than the old /billing/faq path.

infra-bot: Automated check: PR #421 contains 2 changed files, 5 additions, 3 deletions. Link-checker: 1 external 404, 0 broken images. Lint: code-sample style warning in sdk-js.md.

kai: For the SDK snippets, let's ensure examples use the new grouped client pattern: `const client = new Redwood({apiKey})` -> then `client.text.generate()` for text and `client.embeddings.create()` for embeddings. Also show streaming with an async iterator for JS.

mira t: Good call — I added streaming examples for both Python and JS. Python shows `for chunk in resp.stream():` pattern. Also added a short comment about where to set REDWOOD_API_KEY (env vs direct).

product-ops: Can we add a single-line pricing example that ties rate-limits to cost? e.g., "Assuming 10k tokens/day at $0.0004/token, monthly cost ≈ $1.2k" — helps Sales with quick answers.

leo: Add that but flag it's illustrative and not a quote. Also include an example of the metering rounding: "Usage is rounded up to 10-token buckets for billing." Customers trip on that.

sophie: I suggested a tiny note about burst semantics: "Short bursts (under 60s) may exceed per-second limits if minute-level capacity allows; sustained exceedance triggers 429s and counts toward quota enforcement." Kept it terse.

infra-bot: CI comment: style-check failed for sdk-js.md — missing code fence language tag. Also link-checker still reports external 404 for /support/billing/usage-billing-guide (redirect not published).

kai: I'll update the JS snippet and push a quick redirect change to the internal docs site to make that /support/billing/usage-billing-guide live.

mira t: Pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ab4c9d2 — fixed anchors, updated dashboard links, swapped SDKs, added billing example and burst paragraph.

leo: Reviewed and left one nit: change "per-minute meter name (token-minutes)" to exact label `token_minutes` to match Grafana metric naming.

product-ops: Also request: add a one-line note that quota resets at 00:00 UTC unless customer has custom rollover. Small but saves ticketing.

sophie: Approved after nit. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: PR #421 merged by mira t — Deployment: docs site rebuild queued. Build URL: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/99123.

mira t: Thank you all — I'll follow up with a short changelog snippet for release notes and a heads-up email to support with the billing rounding example.

leo: Nice, thanks!
